## [1.3.0](https://github.com/Gagan-Pratap-S/GT-morphe-patches/compare/v1.2.0...v1.3.0) (2026-11-22)

### ✨ New Features

* **dialer:** apply full v7 dynamic Material 3 AMOLED palette across values-v31 and values-v34 ([cb0735f](https://github.com/Gagan-Pratap-S/GT-morphe-patches/commit/cb0735f26084ca18018379278ac0c0192ad6cde1))

patches.name: AMOLED Dark Theme
patches.description: Converts Google Phone dark theme from grey into pure pitch-black (#000000), enhances dialpad readability with pure white text, and fixes unsaved contact avatar outlines.

patches.name: Clone Dialer Package
patches.description: Changes package to com.google.android.dialer.amoled for non-rooted install. Leave OFF on rooted devices to mount over stock dialer without crashing.

patches.name: Fix Cloned DroidGuard Crash
patches.description: Prevents Google Phone from crashing on launch when running as a cloned package on non-rooted devices.
